{{Lunisolar August}}
'''August 20''' is the 20th day of the month {{ill|August (Lunisolar)|ja|8月 (旧暦)|lt=August (Hazuki)}}, the 8th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}}. Its {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}} day is {{ill|senpu|qid=Q96759842}}{{efn|ja|先負|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}}{{efn|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}}{{efn|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Senbu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 六曜|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}}.
